div.head: VI As 11
div.ab: Endlyfte, þæt Æþelstan béot his bisceopum ⁊ his ealdormannum ⁊ his gerefum eallum ofer ealne minne ánweald, þæt ge þone frið swa healdan swa ic hine gerǽdd habbe ⁊ mine witan. Gif eower hwilc forgymeleasað ⁊ me hyran nelle ⁊ þæt wedd æt his hyremannum níman nelle ⁊ he geþafað þa dyrnan geþingo ⁊ emban þa stéoran swa beon nelle, swa ic beboden hæbbe, ⁊ on urum gewritum stent, þonne beo se gerefa buton his folgoðe ⁊ buton minum freondscipe ⁊ gesylle me CXX scll', ⁊ be healfum þam ælc minra þegna, þe gelandod sy ⁊ þa stéore swa healdan nelle, swa ic beboden habbe.

Undecimum est, quod Æþelstanus rex precipit episcopis suis et prepositis suis omnibus in toto regno suo, ut pacem ita custodiant, sicut recitauit et sapientes eius (sui). Si aliquis uestrum supersedeat et non pareat et (obtemperet, cur) hoc uadium ab hyremannis (uel a subditis) suis capere nolit et patiatur occultas actiones et de iustitia non procurabit, sicut precepi et in scripturis nostris (scriptis) instituimus, perdat prepositus preposituram suam et amicitiam meam (nostram) et emendet michi (regi) CXX sol., et dimidium hoc omnis thainus (uel baro) meus, qui terrarius sit et iusticiam ita seruare noluerit, sicut statui (institui).

Endlyfte: Þæt Æþelstan béot his bisceopum ⁊ his ealdormannum ⁊ his gerefum eallum ofer ealne minne ánweald, þæt ge þone frið swa healdan swa ic hine gerǽdd habbe ⁊ mine witan. Gif eower hwilc forgymeleasað ⁊ me hyran nelle ⁊ þæt wedd æt his hyremannum níman nelle ⁊ he geþafað þa dyrnan geþingo ⁊ emban þa stéoran swa beon nelle, swa ic beboden haebbe, ⁊ on urum gewritum stent, þonne beo se gerefa buton his folgoðe ⁊ buton minum freondscipe ⁊ gesylle me CXX scll., ⁊ be healfum þam ælc minra þegna, þe gelandod sy ⁊ þa stéore swa healdan nelle, swa ic beboden habbe.

Elftens, dass (König Quadr.) Aethelstan seinen Bischöfen und seinen Ealdormen und seinen Vögten allen über mein ganzes Gebiet hin befiehlt, dass ihr die Friedensordnung so haltet, wie ich sie beschlossen habe mit meinen Witan. Wenn einer von euch nachlässig ist und mir nicht gehorchen will, indem er jenes [Friedens-]Versprechen seinen Untergebenen nicht abnehmen will und die heimlichen Abfindungen [mit Umgehung des Gerichts] erlaubt und um die Zucht [und Ordnung] nicht so [bemüht] sein will, wie ich geboten habe und in unseren Satzungsartikeln steht, dann sei solcher Vogt aus seinem Amt und meiner Freundschaft [ausgestossen] und zahle mir 120 Schill., und halb so viel [zahle] jeder meiner Thegnas, der Land [und Leute] besitzt und die Zucht [und Ordnung] nicht so, wie ich geboten habe, beobachten will.

Eleventhly, that (King, Quadr.) Æthelstan commands his bishops and his ealdormen and all his reeves throughout my whole dominion that you keep the peace-ordinance as I have decided it with my witan. If any of you is negligent and will not obey me, by not taking that [peace-]pledge from his dependants and allowing secret settlements [bypassing the court] and not being [concerned] about discipline [and order] as I have commanded and as stands in our articles, then let such a reeve be [expelled] from his office and from my friendship and pay me 120 shillings, and let each of my thegns who holds land [and people] and will not observe discipline [and order] as I have commanded [pay] half as much.

Eleventh: Æthelstan commands his bishops and his ealdormen, and all his reeves throughout his dominions: You shall observe the provisions for the public security which I and my councillors have ordained. If any of you is neglectful and unwilling to obey me, and will not exact from those under his jurisdiction the [above-mentioned] pledge; and if he permits secret compacts, and is unwilling to attend to the duties of government, in accordance with what I have commanded and set down in writing—the reeve shall be deprived of his office and of my friendship, and he shall pay me 120 shillings; and half this sum shall be paid by each of my thegns who is in possession of land, and is unwilling to attend to the duties of government in accordance with my commands.

Eleventhly: Athelstan commands his bishops and his ealdormen and all his reeves over all my dominion, that you observe the peace just as I and my councillors have enacted it. If any of you neglects and will not obey me, and will not take the pledge from those subject to him, and if he consents to secret compacts, and will not so concern himself with keeping order as I have commanded and as it stands in our writings, then is the reeve to be without his office and without my friendship, and to pay me 120 shillings, and half that each of my thegns [is to pay] who owns land and will not so maintain order as I have commanded.

Fortan spricht der König selbst, z. T. in erster Person. Die Gilde hat also das Staatsgesetz hier nur wörtlich ausgeschrieben. Und zwar laut 12, 1 ein zu Witlanburg gegebenes. Dessen Inhalt deckt sich teilweise mit dem in c. 10 von früheren Reichstagen Berichteten

From here on the king himself speaks, in part in the first person. The guild has thus merely copied out the law of the State word for word here; and indeed, according to 12, 1, one issued at Witlanburg. Its content partly coincides with what is reported in c. 10 of earlier national assemblies

Unten sind neben Vögten auch die private Gerichtsbarkeit (s. d. Gl 11b) übenden Thegnas genannt, unter jenen also nicht allein Sheriffs (so Schmid; s. o. 10⁷), sondern auch staatliche Ortsvögte gemeint

Below, besides reeves, thegns exercising private jurisdiction (see that word in Gl 11b) are also named; by the former, therefore, not only sheriffs are meant (so Schmid; see above 10⁷) but also local reeves of the State
Auf einem Reichstag vór oder nach Thundersfield; denn von diesem war der König laut c. 10 abwesend
At a national assembly before or after Thundersfield; for according to c. 10 the king was absent from that one

Die Worte ⁊ on u. g. s. scheinen mir vom Gildenschreiber ins Königsgesetz hinein interpoliert. Er brauchte sie o. 8, 5³ vom Gildenstatut. Der Plural hat (gegen ‘writs’ Price, ‘Schriften’ Schmid) wieder singularen Sinn

The words ⁊ on u. g. s. seem to me to have been interpolated into the king’s law by the guild scribe. He used them above 8, 5³ of the guild statute. The plural (against ‘writs’ Price, ‘writings’ Schmid) again has singular sense
Vogt und Thegn straft gleich hoch V As 1, 4
V As 1, 4 punishes reeve and thegn equally heavily
land bedeutet nicht bloss ‘Grundeigen’, sondern auch die daran hängende Gerichtsbarkeit; s. d. Gl 2a. 3
land means not merely ‘landed property’ but also the jurisdiction attached to it; see that word in Gl 2a. 3
Lit. ‘my dominions,’ with change to the first person.
See note to V As. cap. 3 § 1.
Lit. ‘in accordance with what…stands in our documents.’
i.e. the possession of land which involves private jurisdiction (Liebermann).
